components.css: .ds-session{font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#26372e);border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d2d7ca);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#d2d7ca);margin-top:16px;padding:13px 0 12px}.ds-heading,.ds-counts{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.ds-heading h2{font-size:13px;margin:0;font-weight:650}.ds-session-stop{font:600 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;border:1px solid var(--rule,#d2d7ca);padding:5px 11px;background:transparent;border-radius:5px;color:var(--danger,#9c3827);cursor:pointer}.ds-session-stop:not(:disabled):hover{background:#f4e3dc;border-color:var(--danger,#9c3827)}.ds-session-stop:disabled{color:var(--muted,#596256);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-session-stop:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#324c41);outline-offset:4px}.ds-progress{display:block;width:100%;height:4px;border:0;border-radius:0;margin-top:12px;appearance:none}.ds-progress::-webkit-progress-bar{background:#e0e4d9}.ds-progress::-webkit-progress-value{background:var(--green,#324c41)}.ds-progress::-moz-progress-bar{background:var(--green,#324c41)}.ds-counts{color:var(--muted,#596256);font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-top:9px}.ds-message{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#596256);margin:10px 0 0;line-height:1.4}

narrative.overview:
The quiet writing slip gives a compact Chrome utility the clarity of paper and green ink. A pale ground, restrained rules, native system text, and a large passage field keep the prepared text central. The interface uses a single column and small, legible controls rather than a decorative application shell.

The built popup expresses that world through local save feedback, tabular counts, a thin progress rule, and visible keyboard controls. Color identifies focus, action, and errors; it does not carry session meaning alone. The approved direction lives in the surface brief; this document records the implemented visual vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Pale paper, green ink, and restrained red feedback.
Native system typography with tabular numeric readouts.
Flat surfaces separated by thin rules.
A spacious passage field inside a compact utility.

rules.name: The Green Ink Rule
rules.body: Green marks focus, progress, and utility actions. Red is reserved for Stop and error feedback.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Use paper tones, one-pixel rules, and focus outlines for separation; the built popup has no shadows.

dos: Do keep the pale paper ground and green focus/action treatment.
Do pair session color with explicit status text and acknowledged character counts.
Do use the native system font stack and tabular numerals for counts and pace.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and the textarea’s native vertical resize.
Do preserve the popup width cap and allow explanatory text to wrap.
Do describe draft locality precisely: the destination website receives typed text.
donts: Don't add shadows, decorative imagery, or display typography to this established utility.
Don't use color alone to distinguish paused, stopped, complete, or error states.
Don't add a popup Start button that replaces the explicit destination keyboard command.
Don't claim a breakpoint, animation, reduced-motion override, or editor compatibility that the implementation does not provide.
